graders.name: consumer-warning
graders.criteria: If the review recommends moving, renumbering or removing the tag-check step, it notes that `docs/releasing.md` cites it as step 3 and needs updating, or recommends referring to it by name. If it recommends no such change, pass.

graders.name: findings
graders.criteria: The final message is a review in conversation with at least two correct, material findings supported by the files, such as the history lines, no-op emphasis, the duplicated ticket-ID and heading rules, or the package.json scripts that do not belong to the task.

graders.name: keeps-safeguards
graders.criteria: The final message does not recommend dropping the `git tag --list` safeguard, the exact headings that `scripts/publish.py` parses, or the no-ticket-IDs preference without an equivalent replacement.

graders.name: no-edit
graders.description: A read-only request changes no files.

graders.name: no-writes
graders.description: The transcript shows no file writes, even ones later undone.
